description: Source code for Lua's string table management, including string creation, resizing, and hashing functions.

methods.name: luaS_resize
methods.description: Resizes the string table, rehashing all strings into a new hash size.

methods.name: luaS_newlstr
methods.description: Creates a new Lua string or returns an existing one if identical string is found.

methods.name: luaS_newudata
methods.description: Creates a new userdata object with specified size and environment.
